ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent options risk management council that stress-tests retail F&O positions against extreme market volatility and enforces deterministic stop-loss gates before execution.
ideas.problem_statement: SEBI found that 87.7% of individual equity-derivatives traders made net losses, necessitating advanced risk controls beyond simple trailing stops in Delta Exchange's AlgoHub.
ideas.title: DeltaShield Options Risk Council
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-agent thesis-falsification pattern from winning autonomous trading projects, appealing directly to judges looking to protect retail traders from catastrophic F&O drawdowns.

ideas.pitch: A natural-language options strategy constructor and backtester specifically tailored for multi-leg derivative spreads, translating conversational intents into executable Algo Builder schemas.
ideas.problem_statement: F&O traders struggle with complex multi-leg strategy construction and lack intuitive AI interfaces within current Algo Marketplace and Algo Builder tools.
ideas.title: OptionsAlpha Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on an active, working live demo that transforms complex options mathematics into simple natural language execution, fulfilling the core challenge brief of building beyond current Delta Exchange features.

ideas.pitch: An algorithmic execution bot that detects and automatically capitalizes on implied versus realized volatility discrepancies across Delta Exchange's options order books.
ideas.problem_statement: Retail derivatives traders fail due to poor execution timing and a lack of sophisticated quantitative arbitrage tools in standard retail trading bots.
ideas.title: VolArb Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings institutional-grade quant execution and deterministic risk guards to a retail hackathon, standing out through rigorous mathematical backing.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized algorithmic strategy marketplace featuring verifiable track records and zero-knowledge or transparent performance audits before users copy-trade strategies.
ideas.problem_statement: Retail copy-traders face immense losses by subscribing to unverified, high-risk trading bots in existing strategy marketplaces without transparent historical stress-testing.
ideas.title: AlgoTrust Marketplace Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines verifiable performance tracking with secure execution flows, adopting marketplace architecture proven in previous hackathon wins.

ideas.pitch: A real-time analytics dashboard parsing Delta Exchange trade data streams to visualize aggregate F&O trader positioning, gamma exposure, and liquidation heatmaps.
ideas.problem_statement: Individual equity-derivatives traders lack granular, real-time visibility into market-wide positioning and institutional order flow imbalances.
ideas.title: GreeksPulse Trade Data Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an immediately useful data-visualization tool that directly addresses why retail traders lose money—flying blind without market microstructure insights.
